meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: Claude 将改用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 三个工具探索代码：先搜索符号和文件，再查看文件结构，最后按需展开函数或类的源码，而不是直接读取整个文件。
howto.when: 当你要求理解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时，或技能被激活后，Claude 不再用 Read/Glob/Grep 做初步探索，而是优先调用 smart_* 工具。

say.text: 查找项目中所有 shutdown 相关的函数
say.note: 会调用 smart_search 返回符号列表

say.text: 看看 services/worker-service.ts 里有什么结构
say.note: 会调用 smart_outline 显示文件骨架

howto.what_en: Claude will replace its default exploration with smart_search, smart_outline, and smart_unfold: first search for symbols/files, then outline file structure, then unfold a specific symbol's source on demand instead of reading whole files.
howto.when_en: When you ask to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase, or when the skill is active, Claude prioritizes the smart_* tools over Read/Glob/Grep for initial discovery.

say_en.text: Find all shutdown-related functions in the project.
say_en.note: Calls smart_search to return ranked symbols.
Calls smart_outline for a file skeleton.
Calls smart_unfold for the full implementation.
